mapper.sql: id, book_id, reader_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (book_id, reader_id, borrow_time, due_time, status) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{readerId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET return_time = #{returnTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM borrow_record WHERE reader_id = #{readerId} AND status IN ('BORROWED', 'OVERDUE')

SELECT br.id, br.book_id, br.reader_id, br.borrow_time, br.due_time, br.return_time, br.status, br.create_time, br.update_time, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn AS book_isbn, r.name AS reader_name FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN reader r ON br.reader_id = r.id WHERE br.status IN ('OVERDUE', 'BORROWED') AND br.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND br.return_time IS NULL ORDER BY br.due_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM borrow_record WHERE status IN ('OVERDUE', 'BORROWED') AND due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND return_time IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM borrow_record WHERE status IN ('BORROWED', 'OVERDUE')

SELECT br.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn AS book_isbn, COUNT(br.id) AS borrow_cnt FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id GROUP BY br.book_id, b.title, b.isbn ORDER BY borrow_cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
